claims: Artemis II crew splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
Artemis II splashdown occurred on Friday, April 10, 2026.
Artemis II splashdown occurred at 8:07 p.m. ET (5:07 p.m. PT).
Orion capsule completed a 10-day moon mission.
Orion capsule was recovered by the U.S. Navy near the USS John P. Murtha.
USS John P. Murtha was the recovery ship for Artemis II.
Reid Wiseman was the commander of the Artemis II crew.
Victor Glover was the pilot of the Artemis II crew.
Christina Koch was the mission specialist of the Artemis II crew.
Jeremy Hansen was the Canadian astronaut on the Artemis II crew.
Artemis II was the first crewed lunar mission since 1972.
